agent_explanation: Single ball dropped from rest near floor with e=1, gravity 14.78, dt~0.0207 bounces repeatedly. No controller work. Energy rises monotonically across bounces (E0~139.9 to ~157.9 at step 90 to ~158.9 at step 94). Likely cause is contact solver adding energy on nominally elastic impacts: impulse plus positional correction applied while gravity injects momentum during substeps, and semi-implicit Euler integration does not conserve energy, so each bounce returns slightly more mechanical energy than it had, accumulating beyond 10%+5J tolerance over ~94 steps.
